name: singlet_enrichment_per_cell_gene_set_scoring
title: Per-cell gene set scoring
description: Scores each cell for each predefined gene set, optionally signed with up and down members, and writes a cells-by-sets matrix to obsm/gene_set_score. The default method ucell reads raw counts; module-style methods need a log-normalised layer. Use it for per-cell activity; use enrichment.pseudobulk_pathway_scoring for sample-level scores and enrichment.differential_pathway_activity for contrasts. Do not compare scores across different gene universes.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Input layer: counts for ucell and aucell; lognorm for module_score, score_genes and zscore.

gene_sets.description: uns key of the gene-set collection, or a GMT file path; each set has up and down member lists.

method.description: Scoring method. ucell is the default; the others exist for comparison and transfer checks.

set_size.description: Set size limits, counted on members present in the data.

min.description: Drop sets with fewer present members than this.

max.description: Drop sets with more present members than this.

threshold.description: Write obs/<set>_active where a score exceeds this value; null writes no calls.

null_n_sets.description: Matched random sets for an empirical null z-score (proposed); 0 disables it.

max_rank.description: Rank cap for the Mann-Whitney statistic; members ranked beyond it count as maxRank.

ties.description: Tie handling when ranking genes within each cell.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for null-set sampling and module-style control sampling.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, sets_scored, sets_dropped, dropped_sets, null_calibrated. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
